title: How Many Pages Does the Book Have? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A book's pages are numbered from 1, and the digits printed are exactly twice the number of pages. How many pages?
Vantee counts the digits in groups, then shows a quick balance trick, the common traps, and a three-times challenge.
